name: Classic Parchment Ayatul Kursi Calligraphy
short_desc: This timeless Islamic calligraphy artwork presents the complete Ayatul Kursi in a structured circular layout on a fine cream-toned parchment background. Crafted with rich black and red acrylic paints, detailed burned-corner flourishes, and a protective gloss varnish, this framed piece brings a scholarly, dignified atmosphere to any home office or library.
seo_title: : Classic Parchment Ayatul Kursi Calligraphy – Traditional Hand-Painted Acrylic Islamic Art with Varnish Finish
description:
Imbue your space with sacred tradition and refined elegance through this hand-crafted Islamic calligraphy artwork. The piece features a beautifully balanced circular composition of Ayatul Kursi, anchored in the inner core by the powerful central script, while the sacred name "Allah" stands out prominently at the top in a striking crimson red hue.

Painted with high-grade acrylic paints, the artwork showcases an authentic vintage manuscript style. The background is rendered in a warm, textured cream parchment tone, accented at the corners by subtle brown scorched-flourish details. The crisp black Kufic and Thuluth-inspired Arabic lettering creates a clean, high-contrast effect that demands respect and quiet reflection.

To safeguard its beauty and maintain lasting quality, the artwork is treated with a protective gloss varnish seal. This varnish layer shields the painted surface against dust, humidity, and UV fading while adding a refined lustre that accentuates every intricate pen stroke under direct lighting.

Framed in rich dark wood with an inner gold trim, this traditional artwork serves as an ideal centerpiece for executive study rooms, home libraries, formal sitting areas, or entryway walls, offering a timeless expression of faith and classical artistry.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish finish for long-lasting color preservation

Theme & Script: Circular Ayatul Kursi composition with prominent red "Allah" script

Color Palette: Warm cream background, deep black lettering, crimson red accents, and subtle burnt-sienna corner details

Style: Traditional Islamic Manuscript / Classical Calligraphy

Ideal Placement: Home office, library, study room, or formal reception area
